新闻掏宝
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报道，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 狗狗老友记英
programme.desc: 在北加州，法国斗牛犬迪尔和小猪酸瓜喜欢在一起，尤其是一起上障碍训练班、洗澡和在海滩上长途散步。在佛罗里达州，一匹名叫水星的年轻治疗迷你马与牠的朋友、一只马雷马牧羊犬天狼星建立了意想不到的情谊。

programme.title: 天气报告英 及 财经消息英
食尽全世界英
programme.desc: 萨希在今集特别篇去了迷人的塞舌尔，探索其原始海滩、独特的野生动物、豪华度假酒店和丰富美食。从学做传统的章鱼咖喱到品尝鲜烤龙虾和红鱼，他体验到终极的岛屿奢华享受，美景和海鲜，这绝对是难忘的美食历险之旅。

programme.title: 放眼世界英
programme.desc: 今集探索大洋洲西部的自然奇景，以新西兰的壮丽大地和豪勋爵岛为焦点，展示火山、古洞、冰川、森林、山河等，同时看看独特野生动物。透过毛利传说、文化遗产和保育工作，表扬这区的地理、生物多样性和环保的重要。

programme.title: 食尽全世界英
programme.desc: 萨希在今集特别篇去了迷人的塞舌尔，探索其原始海滩、独特的野生动物、豪华度假酒店和丰富美食。从学做传统的章鱼咖喱到品尝鲜烤龙虾和红鱼，他体验到终极的岛屿奢华享受，美景和海鲜，这绝对是难忘的美食历险之旅。

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #41 粤
programme.desc: 如花有身孕，宁王认为老来得子是吉兆，宁王表示逆我者杀，文宾惟有臣服。凤姐叫皇上三跪九叩认错，皇上照办。华太师惊悉秋香是假的，伯虎向秋月试探，却全被秋月通过。原来华太师早怀疑秋月而扮癫，伯虎不信。

programme.title: 熟男有惑 #19 粤
programme.desc: 嘉莹收到钟家的律师信，嘉婷才知道钟家要争夺儿子的抚养权；盛鸣以嘉莹代表律师的身分与代表定亨的卢苏谈判。嘉婷申请强制令逼盛鸣接受手术，欲找爵士担任代表律师，但爵士因情伤提不起劲。盛鸣提出单方面申请离婚，嘉婷心神恍惚下被车撞倒。卢苏向嘉莹表示嘉婷交通意外后，即使醒来也无法照顾盛况，劝她让出盛况抚养权。Fanny请爵士替她办理离婚，她要求爵士送一首离婚歌给她。尤蜜向爵士作出亲密举动，爵士竟避开。Mary把数张罗兰裸照交给嘉莹，嘉莹明白相片可换回儿子……

programme.title: 熟男有惑 #20 粤
programme.desc: (大结局)爵士看扁多春无法走出困局，多春却决定移居法国。四男在球场叹气之际，看见几位年轻人在炫耀感情生活，有所感触。四男决定以投篮决定自己的命运，可是轮到卢苏时，他表示自己根本没有选择权。罗兰向卢苏问及裸照由来，更提到六年前迫卢苏拆散了儿子与嘉莹之事……嘉婷苏醒后，性情却变得与盛鸣相似，表示明白盛鸣的想法；Fanny的离婚派对上，爵士鼓起勇气献唱，令台下的尤蜜十分感动。丽莎挺著大肚子到法国的农场寻找多春，谁知甫到埗，便见丈夫与三名年轻法国女子于屋内谈笑甚欢，不禁妒火中烧……

programme.title: 忠奸人 #9 粤
programme.desc: 启源被卷入涉嫌洗黑钱的诉讼中，敏晖要求哲行担任启源的辩方律师。另一方面，美贞逐渐放下当年被冤枉入狱的阴影，与立勋成为朋友。承义自从正华被绑架事件后，突然变得奢华，引起立勋怀疑。承义利用职权将资料带给绰姿，让绰姿能够完成论文，以铿夫妇目睹，嘉莉更误以为绰姿喜欢承义。子聪对哲行被重视感妒忌，竟设计陷害美贞让哲行难堪。哲行为了研究启源的案件，翻查有关议员及黑帮景昌的新闻，在调查时，哲行却在剪报中找出了与美贞一案的关联点。哲行思前想后，感觉到整件事情并不单纯……

programme.title: 忠奸人 #10 粤
programme.desc: 敏晖决定撤换哲行，并改由子聪负责启源一案，哲行开始反思自己为何会失去敏晖的信任。另一方面，美贞得知哲行之事后，便亲自下厨，以表示与哲行同甘共苦的决心。立勋与漫冰跟踪正华，发现他欲自杀，立勋救回正华更说服他成为污点证人。承义心知在警队中难有发展，便努力推销自己欲替以铿工作。绰姿向以铿澄清自己与承义的关系，之后约承义在启源的餐厅见面，承义却在餐厅中发现刘焱与永光竟有所关连。正华在警方安排的安全屋藏身，但不知何故被人发现，凶徒出现要对付正华，立勋带著正华逃走时被凶徒用电枪击晕……

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #64 粤
programme.desc: 恒看到徒弟李太严厉地对待媳妇，暗暗羡慕，李太以「错又闹，唔错又闹」的心得「传授」给恒，但岚令恒无从挑剔。恒发现岚掉失她视为至宝的「黑盒」，二人因而闹翻。恒发现「黑盒」在自己房内，将「黑盒」放到岚房中。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #65 粤
programme.desc: 乔Sir拉拢亮，要她考虑参加海外课程，可是亮却以韦不批准婉拒。亮捧花回家，韦追问花束，亮说是乔Sir所赠，韦私下查乔Sir，发现他各方面都胜过自己。晚上韦更偷听到亮与一名男子的通话，该男子更向亮示爱。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #66 粤
programme.desc: 明将娜的「八字」交给龙在天，天只留下「大利东方」八个字。明要娜迁入「东方」办公室，岚反对，明要辞退岚，信说出他暗恋的正是岚，明心脏病发入院。天赠以「一子去，一子还」六字。明长子本来到医院与明相认！

programme.desc: 启源被卷入涉嫌洗黑钱的诉讼中，敏晖要求哲行担任启源的辩方律师。另一方面，美贞逐渐放下当年被冤枉入狱的阴影，与立勋成为朋友。承义自从正华被绑架事件后，突然变得奢华，引起立勋怀疑。承义利用职权将资料带给绰姿，让绰姿能够完成论文，以铿夫妇目睹，嘉莉更误以为绰姿喜欢承义。子聪对哲行被重视感妒忌，竟设计陷害美贞让哲行难堪。哲行为了研究启源的案件，翻查有关议员及黑帮景昌的新闻，在调查时，哲行却在剪报中找出了与美贞一案的关联点。哲行思前想后，感觉到整件事情并不单纯……

programme.title: 忠奸人 #10 粤
programme.desc: 敏晖决定撤换哲行，并改由子聪负责启源一案，哲行开始反思自己为何会失去敏晖的信任。另一方面，美贞得知哲行之事后，便亲自下厨，以表示与哲行同甘共苦的决心。立勋与漫冰跟踪正华，发现他欲自杀，立勋救回正华更说服他成为污点证人。承义心知在警队中难有发展，便努力推销自己欲替以铿工作。绰姿向以铿澄清自己与承义的关系，之后约承义在启源的餐厅见面，承义却在餐厅中发现刘焱与永光竟有所关连。正华在警方安排的安全屋藏身，但不知何故被人发现，凶徒出现要对付正华，立勋带著正华逃走时被凶徒用电枪击晕……

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #64 粤
programme.desc: 恒看到徒弟李太严厉地对待媳妇，暗暗羡慕，李太以「错又闹，唔错又闹」的心得「传授」给恒，但岚令恒无从挑剔。恒发现岚掉失她视为至宝的「黑盒」，二人因而闹翻。恒发现「黑盒」在自己房内，将「黑盒」放到岚房中。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #65 粤
programme.desc: 乔Sir拉拢亮，要她考虑参加海外课程，可是亮却以韦不批准婉拒。亮捧花回家，韦追问花束，亮说是乔Sir所赠，韦私下查乔Sir，发现他各方面都胜过自己。晚上韦更偷听到亮与一名男子的通话，该男子更向亮示爱。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #66 粤
programme.desc: 明将娜的「八字」交给龙在天，天只留下「大利东方」八个字。明要娜迁入「东方」办公室，岚反对，明要辞退岚，信说出他暗恋的正是岚，明心脏病发入院。天赠以「一子去，一子还」六字。明长子本来到医院与明相认！

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #41 粤
programme.desc: 如花有身孕，宁王认为老来得子是吉兆，宁王表示逆我者杀，文宾惟有臣服。凤姐叫皇上三跪九叩认错，皇上照办。华太师惊悉秋香是假的，伯虎向秋月试探，却全被秋月通过。原来华太师早怀疑秋月而扮癫，伯虎不信。

programme.title: 熟男有惑 #19 粤
programme.desc: 嘉莹收到钟家的律师信，嘉婷才知道钟家要争夺儿子的抚养权；盛鸣以嘉莹代表律师的身分与代表定亨的卢苏谈判。嘉婷申请强制令逼盛鸣接受手术，欲找爵士担任代表律师，但爵士因情伤提不起劲。盛鸣提出单方面申请离婚，嘉婷心神恍惚下被车撞倒。卢苏向嘉莹表示嘉婷交通意外后，即使醒来也无法照顾盛况，劝她让出盛况抚养权。Fanny请爵士替她办理离婚，她要求爵士送一首离婚歌给她。尤蜜向爵士作出亲密举动，爵士竟避开。Mary把数张罗兰裸照交给嘉莹，嘉莹明白相片可换回儿子……

programme.title: 熟男有惑 #20 粤
programme.desc: (大结局)爵士看扁多春无法走出困局，多春却决定移居法国。四男在球场叹气之际，看见几位年轻人在炫耀感情生活，有所感触。四男决定以投篮决定自己的命运，可是轮到卢苏时，他表示自己根本没有选择权。罗兰向卢苏问及裸照由来，更提到六年前迫卢苏拆散了儿子与嘉莹之事……嘉婷苏醒后，性情却变得与盛鸣相似，表示明白盛鸣的想法；Fanny的离婚派对上，爵士鼓起勇气献唱，令台下的尤蜜十分感动。丽莎挺著大肚子到法国的农场寻找多春，谁知甫到埗，便见丈夫与三名年轻法国女子于屋内谈笑甚欢，不禁妒火中烧……

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #42 粤
programme.desc: 秋月欲利用潮涨将秋香浸死，秋月更掳去皇上，刘瑾得到皇上即给解药秋月，废去秋月武功。秋月向虎透露自己是东厂杀手，华太师猜掳皇上主谋是宁王，皇上得悉宁王作反。如花求子健带她离京，免宁王知她腹中块肉属子健。

programme.title: 通天干探 #1 粤
programme.desc: 少林寺来港慈善表演，拥有特异能力，法号净海的新亦随队抵港，记者们纷纷进行采访，并问有关童子功。保在街坊前称懂童子功，但师奶们都半信半疑。表演当晚的录影厂内，新遇上行径古怪的勤，结果将他制服。新回想起十年前的憾事。新重遇昔日旧上司超Sir，两人相约食饭，新告知仍放不下十年前一次行动中误杀青年一事。泰籍男妓功陪伴阔太逛街时遇上莹。原来功是保与莹的租客，保得悉新有意留港后，留他在住所居住，望可赶走功。新初遇功，但发现自己对他有种特别的感觉，此时，超Sir突然失去常性，跳楼身亡。

programme.title: 通天干探 #2 粤
programme.desc: 新因超Sir的死而情绪低落。及后超Sir的验尸报告，竟发现他身体内有很多虫，状甚恐怖。新前往探望超Sir妻子云，云描述超Sir临死的异样，新感可疑。功前往拳馆问坤借钱，被坤打至遍体鳞伤。新到医院探望勤，对方突然发难，跳楼重伤。邦相约功见面，原来功原名龙，是超Sir派往调查坤的卧底，邦命龙停止调查坤，龙拒绝。龙欠下债项，被债主淋红油，保大为劳气，找新帮手教训。勤突然发难，逃到殓房，终证实死亡。而其尸首竟与超sir一样，身体内布满虫，令事件更添迷离。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #11 粤
programme.desc: 歹徒将立勋击倒并将正华掳去，立勋虽平安无事，却令慧英怀疑警队中有人泄露了安全屋的位置。慧英指示立勋带永光回警署问话，其后永光的老板景昌带同律师到警署，慧英只得无奈放人。承义在以铿的公司任职，更继续对绰姿苦苦相缠，以铿得知爱女被骚扰便将承义辞退。警方寻回正华，但他却拒绝再做污点证人，终令启源在洗黑钱案中脱身。哲行支持残障运动会的计划，更托立勋助他找寻赞助商，绰姿得知后安排哲行与以铿见面。承义无力偿还债项走投无路，决定找永光帮忙，但听到景昌吩咐永光解决碍事的人，永光惶恐急走。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #12 粤
programme.desc: 立勋不想承义泥足深陷，让同僚告知承义已被调查，令他能及早回头。哲行成功说服以铿出资举办伤残运动会，但启源对哲行擅自接触以铿一事不满。承义致电向绰姿借钱应急，立勋独自到约定地点寻找承义。永光因被承义录了音，警方掌握了他的犯罪证据，永光唯有成为警方的卧底，但启源成功识破了警方的行动，并让永光潜逃。慧英失去了永光这个重要线索后，更深信警方有内奸泄露警方行踪。哲行因协助启源有功，收到启源所赠的豪宅单位。哲行与美贞到新住所参观，哲行提议美贞搬过来与自己一同生活。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #67 粤
programme.desc: 信曾偷听到本与别人通电话时，提到「收尸」，于是怀疑本。信看到本在向明借钱，他被本击倒在地，明更以「将家产全交给本」威胁，要信辞退岚。信欲无奈就范，但二人在酒后糊涂互吻。翌日信要辞职，更要离家出走。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #68 粤
programme.desc: 本突然向明辞行，原来本是无国界医生。信辞职，四出找工作，但处处碰壁，所有人都觉信最终都会忍受不了而回家。岚要娜出手劝信回家，娜以「女朋友」的身分，要信跟他回家，信道出恋上岚的真相，岚赶到，娜说出一切！

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #69 粤
programme.desc: 岚得悉信暗恋自己，变得不知如何面对信，更诈病请假。娜向明说有方法能解决此事，并要明在事后将「形」的四成股分交给娜，明答应，娜取消信的各项财源。岚与信再次以「好朋友」相称，岚更成功游说信回家认错。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #12 粤
programme.desc: 立勋不想承义泥足深陷，让同僚告知承义已被调查，令他能及早回头。哲行成功说服以铿出资举办伤残运动会，但启源对哲行擅自接触以铿一事不满。承义致电向绰姿借钱应急，立勋独自到约定地点寻找承义。永光因被承义录了音，警方掌握了他的犯罪证据，永光唯有成为警方的卧底，但启源成功识破了警方的行动，并让永光潜逃。慧英失去了永光这个重要线索后，更深信警方有内奸泄露警方行踪。哲行因协助启源有功，收到启源所赠的豪宅单位。哲行与美贞到新住所参观，哲行提议美贞搬过来与自己一同生活。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #67 粤
programme.desc: 信曾偷听到本与别人通电话时，提到「收尸」，于是怀疑本。信看到本在向明借钱，他被本击倒在地，明更以「将家产全交给本」威胁，要信辞退岚。信欲无奈就范，但二人在酒后糊涂互吻。翌日信要辞职，更要离家出走。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #68 粤
programme.desc: 本突然向明辞行，原来本是无国界医生。信辞职，四出找工作，但处处碰壁，所有人都觉信最终都会忍受不了而回家。岚要娜出手劝信回家，娜以「女朋友」的身分，要信跟他回家，信道出恋上岚的真相，岚赶到，娜说出一切！

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #69 粤
programme.desc: 岚得悉信暗恋自己，变得不知如何面对信，更诈病请假。娜向明说有方法能解决此事，并要明在事后将「形」的四成股分交给娜，明答应，娜取消信的各项财源。岚与信再次以「好朋友」相称，岚更成功游说信回家认错。

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #42 粤
programme.desc: 秋月欲利用潮涨将秋香浸死，秋月更掳去皇上，刘瑾得到皇上即给解药秋月，废去秋月武功。秋月向虎透露自己是东厂杀手，华太师猜掳皇上主谋是宁王，皇上得悉宁王作反。如花求子健带她离京，免宁王知她腹中块肉属子健。

programme.title: 通天干探 #1 粤
programme.desc: 少林寺来港慈善表演，拥有特异能力，法号净海的新亦随队抵港，记者们纷纷进行采访，并问有关童子功。保在街坊前称懂童子功，但师奶们都半信半疑。表演当晚的录影厂内，新遇上行径古怪的勤，结果将他制服。新回想起十年前的憾事。新重遇昔日旧上司超Sir，两人相约食饭，新告知仍放不下十年前一次行动中误杀青年一事。泰籍男妓功陪伴阔太逛街时遇上莹。原来功是保与莹的租客，保得悉新有意留港后，留他在住所居住，望可赶走功。新初遇功，但发现自己对他有种特别的感觉，此时，超Sir突然失去常性，跳楼身亡。

programme.title: 通天干探 #2 粤
programme.desc: 新因超Sir的死而情绪低落。及后超Sir的验尸报告，竟发现他身体内有很多虫，状甚恐怖。新前往探望超Sir妻子云，云描述超Sir临死的异样，新感可疑。功前往拳馆问坤借钱，被坤打至遍体鳞伤。新到医院探望勤，对方突然发难，跳楼重伤。邦相约功见面，原来功原名龙，是超Sir派往调查坤的卧底，邦命龙停止调查坤，龙拒绝。龙欠下债项，被债主淋红油，保大为劳气，找新帮手教训。勤突然发难，逃到殓房，终证实死亡。而其尸首竟与超sir一样，身体内布满虫，令事件更添迷离。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #11 粤
programme.desc: 歹徒将立勋击倒并将正华掳去，立勋虽平安无事，却令慧英怀疑警队中有人泄露了安全屋的位置。慧英指示立勋带永光回警署问话，其后永光的老板景昌带同律师到警署，慧英只得无奈放人。承义在以铿的公司任职，更继续对绰姿苦苦相缠，以铿得知爱女被骚扰便将承义辞退。警方寻回正华，但他却拒绝再做污点证人，终令启源在洗黑钱案中脱身。哲行支持残障运动会的计划，更托立勋助他找寻赞助商，绰姿得知后安排哲行与以铿见面。承义无力偿还债项走投无路，决定找永光帮忙，但听到景昌吩咐永光解决碍事的人，永光惶恐急走。

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #43 粤
programme.desc: 守仁欲假造皇上手谕入城救皇上，三子等偷玉石做假玉玺，文宾亦要胁征明雕假玉玺，宁王假传圣旨由自己继位。守仁惶恐之际皇上突然出现。宁王派兵去剿灭败北，于是再派健率大军迎战，子健倒戈，宁王震怒杀劝降大臣。

programme.title: 通天干探 #3 粤
programme.desc: 坤带龙倾生意，龙在饭局中设闭路电视。云对超Sir生前与泰国女子莱过从甚密感伤心。莱主动给钱云，指与超Sir的关系并非如外间想像，云感疑惑。新追查莱时被发现，莱留下信件命新不要随意饮水。如发现三名死者皆家境丰厚，又曾上同一网页浏览，怀疑与快闪党有关。莹随好友参加快闪党，遇上Ray，Ray上门找莹，龙及时扮莹男友，令Ray知难而退。新发现案件与一间教会有关，前往调查，看见教主Rock。龙与坤进行毒品交易，但在当警方准备出动时取消交易，而实则交易并未取消，令邦怀疑龙已经变节。

programme.title: 通天干探 #4 粤
programme.desc: 如派玲与妹混入教会调查Rock，如发现死者尸首内都有某种物质，令寄生虫繁殖迅速，但却不明为何超Sir会牵涉其中。新独自往教会进行调查，却发现莱被囚禁。莱身体满布伤痕，在新追问下，莱终道出自己是Rock女友，指Rock命令她害死超Sir，又指Rock亦是受人所托，莱更说受一名操泰国口音的男子指示。新怀疑是龙，此时新突然被袭。如到教会搜查，并向Rock带回警局查问，却没有所获。新与如到酒吧相聚，Ray趁机将新的水换了，新突然觉得全身发热。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #13 粤
programme.desc: 廉政人员查到承义的户口有一笔不明来历的收入，怀疑承义受贿。美贞担心与哲行同住后会令刘淼感到寂寞，故决定与刘淼一起搬到哲行新居，哲行更希望刘淼能以美贞作为榜样，早日戒除生活陋习。承义一直四处躲藏，立勋找不到他的踪影。绰姿收到了承义的亲笔信，阅毕后因担心承义便偷偷离家与他见面。立勋在两人见面时出现，令承义误以为绰姿出卖自己而逃走，立勋拦截承义后，即要求他鼓起勇气面对自己，但承义仍害怕面对法律制裁而离开。绰姿在街上看见承义从大厦天台跳了下来，绰姿亦因此崩溃痛哭。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #14 粤
programme.desc: 立勋认定承义之死与景昌有关，派人加强扫荡景昌的地盘，景昌则将被警方盯上的责任归咎于启源。绰姿觉得承义之死，自己有极大责任，拒绝与任何人见面，以铿强迫嘉莉放弃工作，要她留在家中看顾绰姿。刘淼回到故居拜祭，却遇上刘焱，刘淼并没有告知兄长美贞的下落。景昌因刘焱突然回港大为紧张，急忙召见启源问话，但启源亦借此机会与景昌划清界线。嘉莉与以铿的关系日渐疏离，而嘉莉经常借故与启源见面，但启源却与嘉莉保持距离。刘焱终得知美贞与哲行交往的事，潜入了哲行的家，逼刘淼说出美贞及哲行的去向。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #70 粤
programme.desc: 明提出以「与惠佳超市合作」来稳定股价，祥质疑。娜色诱旧情人兼惠佳负责人阿南得悉君企划内容。早已收买了南的上司徐柱岳，岚想出要华假扮君致电给岳，讹称受廉政公署调查，要他公平地对待两家公司。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #71 粤
programme.desc: 祥向娜提出在受勋的记者会上，公开与娜关系，菲表示望能得到祥道歉，祥将家传玉器交给娜。娜因此瞬成为传媒追访的对象，就连明也明言希望娜在认亲后，能成为其媳妇，娜希望菲能与祥和好，戴菲却透露娜并非祥的女儿。

programme.title: 同事三分亲 #72 粤
programme.desc: 岚与恒两婆媳又吵了起来，哲成为磨心，依山「妙计」，讹称二人吵架令他无法集中精神，要搬家避开二人，使婆媳二人和好。翌日恒打扫时，发现少了一包燕窝，而刚巧岚偷偷炖燕窝吃，恒怀疑，哲竟想出代岚买回燕窝给恒。

programme.title: 金装四大才子 #43 粤
programme.desc: 守仁欲假造皇上手谕入城救皇上，三子等偷玉石做假玉玺，文宾亦要胁征明雕假玉玺，宁王假传圣旨由自己继位。守仁惶恐之际皇上突然出现。宁王派兵去剿灭败北，于是再派健率大军迎战，子健倒戈，宁王震怒杀劝降大臣。

programme.title: 通天干探 #3 粤
programme.desc: 坤带龙倾生意，龙在饭局中设闭路电视。云对超Sir生前与泰国女子莱过从甚密感伤心。莱主动给钱云，指与超Sir的关系并非如外间想像，云感疑惑。新追查莱时被发现，莱留下信件命新不要随意饮水。如发现三名死者皆家境丰厚，又曾上同一网页浏览，怀疑与快闪党有关。莹随好友参加快闪党，遇上Ray，Ray上门找莹，龙及时扮莹男友，令Ray知难而退。新发现案件与一间教会有关，前往调查，看见教主Rock。龙与坤进行毒品交易，但在当警方准备出动时取消交易，而实则交易并未取消，令邦怀疑龙已经变节。

programme.title: 通天干探 #4 粤
programme.desc: 如派玲与妹混入教会调查Rock，如发现死者尸首内都有某种物质，令寄生虫繁殖迅速，但却不明为何超Sir会牵涉其中。新独自往教会进行调查，却发现莱被囚禁。莱身体满布伤痕，在新追问下，莱终道出自己是Rock女友，指Rock命令她害死超Sir，又指Rock亦是受人所托，莱更说受一名操泰国口音的男子指示。新怀疑是龙，此时新突然被袭。如到教会搜查，并向Rock带回警局查问，却没有所获。新与如到酒吧相聚，Ray趁机将新的水换了，新突然觉得全身发热。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #13 粤
programme.desc: 廉政人员查到承义的户口有一笔不明来历的收入，怀疑承义受贿。美贞担心与哲行同住后会令刘淼感到寂寞，故决定与刘淼一起搬到哲行新居，哲行更希望刘淼能以美贞作为榜样，早日戒除生活陋习。承义一直四处躲藏，立勋找不到他的踪影。绰姿收到了承义的亲笔信，阅毕后因担心承义便偷偷离家与他见面。立勋在两人见面时出现，令承义误以为绰姿出卖自己而逃走，立勋拦截承义后，即要求他鼓起勇气面对自己，但承义仍害怕面对法律制裁而离开。绰姿在街上看见承义从大厦天台跳了下来，绰姿亦因此崩溃痛哭。

programme.title: 忠奸人 #14 粤
programme.desc: 立勋认定承义之死与景昌有关，派人加强扫荡景昌的地盘，景昌则将被警方盯上的责任归咎于启源。绰姿觉得承义之死，自己有极大责任，拒绝与任何人见面，以铿强迫嘉莉放弃工作，要她留在家中看顾绰姿。刘淼回到故居拜祭，却遇上刘焱，刘淼并没有告知兄长美贞的下落。景昌因刘焱突然回港大为紧张，急忙召见启源问话，但启源亦借此机会与景昌划清界线。嘉莉与以铿的关系日渐疏离，而嘉莉经常借故与启源见面，但启源却与嘉莉保持距离。刘焱终得知美贞与哲行交往的事，潜入了哲行的家，逼刘淼说出美贞及哲行的去向。

programme.title: 大长今 #3 粤韩
programme.desc: 故事讲述了韩国历史上传奇女医长今的故事，她处在男尊女卑极其悬殊的时代，历经了她人生路上的坎坷，而最终成为第一位由皇帝御笔钦点的正三品女御医。

programme.title: 黄金面具 #36 粤韩
programme.desc: 华英怀疑宣太在外面有女人，于是派金室长去跟踪宣太。秀妍和流果展开新品牌提案的对决，华英对于真优没出席评选很是不满，狠狠甩了真优一巴掌。真优再也受不了华英的强势，在秀妍面前落泪乞求原谅。

programme.title: Antihero #2 日

programme.title: 锺馗传说 #10 普
programme.desc: 锺馗是中国民间传说中驱鬼辟邪之神，从古至今，锺馗打鬼捉妖的故事几乎人人熟知，足见锺馗在民间的影响极为深广。据古籍记载，锺馗被唐玄宗敕封为“驱魔大神”，遍行天下“斩妖驱邪”；又被玉皇大帝敕封为专管凡尘

programme.title: 卫子夫 #23 普
programme.desc: 参照《史记》、《汉书》相关记载，讲述汉武帝的第二任妻子卫子夫的人生经历。她出身卑微，入宫后生下长子刘据，成为汉武帝刘彻的第二任皇后。她只是一介平民歌女，没有娇艳媚态，没有显赫家势，但却凭著睿智兰心

programme.title: 射雕英雄传 #36 普
programme.desc: 由江南七怪调教而学得一身武艺的郭靖，得蒙古大汗成吉思汗赏识封为「金刀驸马」。郭靖承母命下江南追寻杀父仇人，并往嘉兴赴约比武，途中偶遇伪装成乞丐的桃花岛岛主东邪的女儿黄蓉，从此结下不解之缘

programme.desc: 由江南七怪调教而学得一身武艺的郭靖，得蒙古大汗成吉思汗赏识封为「金刀驸马」。郭靖承母命下江南追寻杀父仇人，并往嘉兴赴约比武，途中偶遇伪装成乞丐的桃花岛岛主东邪的女儿黄蓉，从此结下不解之缘

programme.title: Hands Up #1001 粤
programme.desc: 本集「5-Minute Workout」继续跟着斑马哥哥的指示做锻练，大家先预备好篮球、呼拉圈，并找来一个拍档，当然越多人参与越好，齐齐多做运动。两人一组，各自站在呼拉圈的两侧，跟呼拉圈保留少许距离，然后做出连串的抛球与接球动作，有助训练手眼协调能力，难度亦会随时间而增加。到最后一个阶段，所有人分成两组并「一」字排开，中间排好多个呼拉圈，随即展开随意抛球比赛，有谁接不到就会失分！

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子 #1354 粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子摘了秋樱回家，爷爷带她去买花瓶，但因为不够钱作罢，小丸子于是把汽水瓶拿回去插花。小玉因被父亲缠著拍照而烦恼，小丸子建议让他去找其他拍摄对象，最终把目标定为镇上的老人家。

programme.title: 成语动画廊 #35 粤
programme.desc: 《成语动画廊》以动画手法解说汉语成语的教育片，通过趣味浓厚的动画，让大家分享中国文化的独有宝藏。

programme.title: 问问 Master Joe #188 粤
programme.desc: Y-18透露了Y Pro非常关注气候问题，于是她自制温度计，讲解温度计如何量度温度，同时讲解水银温度计和酒精温度计有何分别？她又用蒸气溶解冰来讲解水的循环。另外，Master Joe会带大家到天文台找温度计，为何这支温度计要受保护？除了温度外，雨量也是需要靠仪器量度的，那么天文台又是怎样收集雨水来量度雨量呢？

programme.title: 魔神创造传 #13 粤日
programme.desc: 阿渡和阿驱打算对打练习，却发现麒麟丸受损严重有待修理，阿驱把麒麟丸拆散，之后却不懂重组回去，因而大受打击，意志消沉。阿渡与睡不著的阿驱聊天，一句无心之言启发后者重新创造魔神。

programme.desc: 本集「5-Minute Workout」继续跟着斑马哥哥的指示做锻练，大家先预备好篮球、呼拉圈，并找来一个拍档，当然越多人参与越好，齐齐多做运动。两人一组，各自站在呼拉圈的两侧，跟呼拉圈保留少许距离，然后做出连串的抛球与接球动作，有助训练手眼协调能力，难度亦会随时间而增加。到最后一个阶段，所有人分成两组并「一」字排开，中间排好多个呼拉圈，随即展开随意抛球比赛，有谁接不到就会失分！

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子 #1354 粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子摘了秋樱回家，爷爷带她去买花瓶，但因为不够钱作罢，小丸子于是把汽水瓶拿回去插花。小玉因被父亲缠著拍照而烦恼，小丸子建议让他去找其他拍摄对象，最终把目标定为镇上的老人家。

programme.title: 成语动画廊 #35 粤
programme.desc: 《成语动画廊》以动画手法解说汉语成语的教育片，通过趣味浓厚的动画，让大家分享中国文化的独有宝藏。

programme.title: 问问 Master Joe #188 粤
programme.desc: Y-18透露了Y Pro非常关注气候问题，于是她自制温度计，讲解温度计如何量度温度，同时讲解水银温度计和酒精温度计有何分别？她又用蒸气溶解冰来讲解水的循环。另外，Master Joe会带大家到天文台找温度计，为何这支温度计要受保护？除了温度外，雨量也是需要靠仪器量度的，那么天文台又是怎样收集雨水来量度雨量呢？

programme.title: 魔神创造传 #13 粤日
programme.desc: 阿渡和阿驱打算对打练习，却发现麒麟丸受损严重有待修理，阿驱把麒麟丸拆散，之后却不懂重组回去，因而大受打击，意志消沉。阿渡与睡不著的阿驱聊天，一句无心之言启发后者重新创造魔神。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子 #1355 粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子看见花轮的教科书划了萤光笔很漂亮，便问他借来一用，好让自己有动力温习。小丸子发现永泽种了丝瓜田，细问之下得知对方要制作丝瓜擦，小丸子于是跟他学造丝瓜擦，以送给爷爷作生日礼物。

programme.title: Hands Up #1003 粤
programme.desc: 这集「Kids’ Notes」嘉宾要为大家演奏乐器，但见他双手空空，到底乐器在哪里？原来只要将两只手掌互握起来，就可「成为」一种名为手笛的乐器！手笛「随手可得」，既没有成本与定期维修费用，「带出门」亦无额外负担，背后的发声原理如何？虽然方便携带、随手拥有，手笛却有音域上的限制。小朋友初次接触，不妨先从只有简单几个音调的儿歌开始，慢慢学习。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子 #1356 粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子想吃番薯蛋糕，但妈妈不肯买，她于是想到用举行读书会作借口，让妈妈买蛋糕回来招待朋友。小丸子化身童话故事《不莱梅乐队》的驴子，与花猫、狗和公鸡结伴前往不莱梅温泉乐园组乐队谋生。

programme.desc: Master Joe怀疑超级粉丝Ryan便是Y Pro的真身，为安心起见，他派出AI进行调查，期间，果然有重大发现。此外，AI也会和同学研究溶解作用。在盐、醋、维他命C片、沙、油和淀粉中，哪种材料可溶于水，哪种不可？当中又有何因素影响著材料的溶解度？天文台的工作人员在平常预测和报告天气时，有什么工序？Master Joe带大家参观报道天气的录影室，并讲解天文台人员在报告天气时，幕前和幕后的工作。

programme.title: 魔神创造传 #15 粤日
programme.desc: 阿翔与麦格奉御罗院之命去阻止阿渡一行人，他们找来化妆高手模仿子假扮成玛萝，试图夺走钿女，却想不到阿渡等人竟然接纳假萝玛嘅存在，两人见计划失败，唯有召唤魔神，与阿渡等人展开激战。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #38

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #39

programme.desc: 特工需要甚么?我们可以用日常物品创造出哪些惊人的发明?米娜有答案。她很快就会向她的朋友们证明科学不一定无聊。事实上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳资源。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #44

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #45

programme.title: 海绵宝宝 英普
programme.desc: 海绵宝宝误把一位逃犯当做他的驾训教练,结果得到教训的是这位新教练 蟹老板派海绵宝宝去寻找遗失的玩具时,海绵宝宝却发现自己在失物招领处迷路了!

programme.title: 海绵宝宝 英普
programme.desc: 泡泡鱼和肮脏泡泡联手成为比奇堡最讨厌最邪恶的麻烦精 皮老板加入海绵宝宝家庭,希望和海绵宝宝更亲近(以及得到祖传秘方)

programme.title: 海绵宝宝 英普
programme.desc: 蟹堡王变得脏兮兮时,一只魔法鱼教海绵宝宝如何维持表面整洁,舔干净! 海绵宝宝被招募到大联盟做菜,但首先,他必须在选拔赛的厨房中证明自己的价值

programme.title: 长尾豹马修一家亲 英普
programme.desc: 洁德同时答应帮助太多人,导致她分身乏术,反而制造更多混乱! 答应等包裹却错过了的长尾豹们,一路追著宅配人员追到了物流站

programme.title: 长尾豹马修一家亲 英普
programme.desc: 比比做网路直播,按赞数却一直没有上升,崔斯特挺身帮忙,差点就暴露了身份 美食评论家到茶壶塔来做餐厅评鉴让奶奶很紧张,并想要做点改变

programme.title: 派大星秀 英普
programme.desc: 鱿鱼妹帮助派大星恢复原型 海星家族接管蟹堡王

programme.title: 派大星秀 英普
programme.desc: 星妈以巧克力口味的罪名惩罚派大星 观众们投票决定派大星的下一步

programme.title: 派大星秀 英普
programme.desc: 海星家的房子离家出走了

programme.title: 雷霆家族:双生卧底
programme.desc: 麦斯假装变坏,潜入首脑的手下之中,窃取能植入晶片,之前让他变坏的晶片发射器

programme.title: 超能势力
programme.desc: 整个猛男巢被发射到外太空之后,超能势力必须让太空船安全降落在地球上,以免瑞克推勒和他的活性感知电脑病毒军团掌控世界,并一举摧毁网路

programme.title: 超能小子亨利
programme.desc: 亨利在弹簧跳床躲避球赛中,运用他的新超能力,因此雷,史瓦兹和夏绿蒂去卧底,要给亨利一个教训

programme.title: 劳德之家 英普

programme.title: 少女怀春

programme.desc: 蔡兰英赏识徐文秀，并赠御赐沉香扇作定情信物，惜英父母禁英再见秀。英女扮男装往找秀不果，却遇吏部尚书陆绍龙，被他收为义子，后英父竟将英许配予龙之义子。秀高中状元往提亲，英几经辛苦解决婚约，与秀结为佳偶。

programme.title: 一后三王
programme.desc: 王良、王超、王络合租一单位，邻居施秀霞钟情良，可是良用情不专，更与超、络出言侮辱霞，于是霞与同事后英使计戏弄三「王」，但最终事情败露。三人质问霞，霞怒斥三人。良悔不当初，与霞重修旧好，有人情终成眷属。

programme.title: 少林英雄左崧传
programme.desc: 左崧被指反清乱贼，遭朝廷通缉。崧与师妹伦美嫦夜探提督府，行刺提督事败。崧欲投靠师弟伦帝荣，岂料荣勾结提督，提督要荣取崧的师伯铁面如来的人头，来为免连累崧，竟自尽。崧、嫦往提督府报仇，终成功把提督杀掉。

programme.title: 孙悟空大闹雷音寺
programme.desc: 蜘蛛精被烧，东海龙王相救。蜘蛛精为了吃唐僧肉，长生不老，遂与黄眉童子利用龙的法宝变出雷音寺。唐中计被困，孙悟空不敌，找来黄眉的师父收服黄眉。蜘蛛精败走龙宫，空穷追，龙不忍杀蜘蛛精，把蜘蛛精收千年蚌内。

programme.desc: 失恋富家子杨昆仑酒后糊涂，与妹的同学张海棠发生关系，随后即往外国升学。棠发现怀孕，仑竟否认错事；棠遭母赶走，历尽辛酸诞子。仑三年后回港，棠以另一身份与仑见面。棠自白经历，仑忆起往事，棠终让仑与子相认。

programme.title: 江湖三女侠(上)
programme.desc: 独臂神尼临终前嘱咐弟子吕四娘完成其遗志。反清首领沈在宽被了恩囚于天牢，四娘与天山弟子唐晓澜及冯瑛赶往相救。他们于宫中遇到琳贵人，原来她是瑛自小失散的妹，在琳的帮忙下救出宽，并手刃了恩，完成神尼的遗愿。

programme.title: 面子问题

programme.title: Circle of Bones

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
programme.desc: 孤儿Azlinda从小就受到鬼魂的困扰,相信这些折磨与父母的暗黑历史密切相关。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz携手合作,希望结束她的痛苦,但却被一个邪恶的恶魔阻挠。Azlinda能否成功斩断

programme.title: 纸人回魂
programme.desc: 一位记者调查二十年前纸人回魂案时,听到三个关于恐怖纸人的故事。故事起源于乔府大小姐乔媛媛枉死后,管家请纸扎匠为小姐做了纸人陪葬。纸人被点眼睛后,大小姐得以借纸人回魂复仇,更接二连三引发连串与纸人有关的

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 当年轻的Evie在海滩上发现一条受诅咒的项链时,她并未察觉其中隐藏的邪恶力量。随著项链的暗黑力量逐渐侵蚀她的意志,她无意中唤醒了恐怖的水魔,而这个水魔将威胁到她和她所爱之人的性命。

programme.title: Room For Rent

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险,传说山中埋著千年女尸,千年不灭之阴火,进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半,依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间,依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间,更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: Tear Us Apart
programme.desc: 幼女离奇失踪后,悲痛的Drew与Helen在治疗师安排下,前往偏远林中小屋接受深度咨商。随著孤立与压抑逐渐侵蚀理智,疗愈之旅化为噩梦。Helen饱受诡异幻象与异象困扰,逐渐分不清现实与幻觉,心智濒临崩

programme.title: Chop Chop

programme.title: 青木劫
programme.desc: 民国初年,富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门,唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间,位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥著灵异惊悚的气氛。随著真相逐渐揭露,这个恐怖的疑团交织著复仇与死亡的动机。

programme.title: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
programme.desc: 一名女警搬进小镇后不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪灵附身的案件所牵引。随著调查层层深入,诡谲真相逐渐浮现,现实与灵异的界线愈发模糊,她亦一步步坠入危机之中。最终,她发现这不仅是一场驱魔之战,更是一段揭开小镇

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: 杰米的妻子在车祸中不幸丧生的一年后,他游说妻子的妹妹与他一起返回事故现场,进行一场古怪的仪式。随著夜幕低垂,杰米明显有行凶的动机。

programme.title: The Elite of Devils
programme.desc: 五名大学生受委派前往一座神秘庄园进行专题研究,并结识了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,却发现她隐藏著致命秘密。随著她的恶魔力量逐渐觉醒,原本的学术之旅瞬间化为生死逃亡,他们必须对抗统治阶层延续数百年的诅咒。

programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: 一个宁静的晚上,一名患精神病的连环杀手扰乱了年轻夫妇的平淡生活。当这对夫妇为生存而战时,他们隐藏多年的秘密亦随之揭开,期间更意外地被牵连到黑社会的地下世界中。

programme.title: 春火
programme.desc: 杨国良是探长儿子,国良怪父沉迷工作,母离世仍在查案,隔膜顿生国良遇上舞女梅琳,两人母亲皆殁,了解下迅即同居生活国良因生活费花尽到俱乐部赌钱,被陈彪骗下巨款,更强奸梅琳国良愤然杀死陈彪,遭警察围捕

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: 华山派大弟子令狐冲要找出一个继承「笑傲江湖」琴谱的人当令狐冲发现任盈盈为合适人选时,却发现她竟是魔教教主任我行之女,同时他亦一步步卷入正邪两道的权斗阴谋和道义两难的困境

programme.title: 猎人
programme.desc: 花花公子周国雄有一本「猎人日记」专门去记录他四出猎艳的故事,周丢弃刘明华,又去追猎吕绮美,刘突然遭人杀死后来周又去追求女学生朱丽珍…但当晚,吕遭杀死,警方向周追查同时周想到和他亲近的女人,一个一个的被杀死,嫌凶渐指向他,好像有人在陷害自己周开始追查真相

programme.title: 少林传人
programme.desc: 九王爷谋朝篡位,率领奸臣叛贼攻入皇宫;皇帝见大势已去,命两名忠心侍卫各抱一名太子突围而出辗转之下,大太子由少林戒律院三僧抚养,法号道行,习得少林绝技;二太子则易名五子泰,由丞相抚养多年后,五子泰前往少林寺借阅「易筋经」,与道行相遇,却不知对方正是亲兄弟……

programme.title: 射雕英雄传续集
programme.desc: 欧阳锋得悉郭靖以九阴真经的功夫于选婿比武中获胜,并娶得黄蓉为妻,于是把黄蓉挟走,要胁郭靖要默写九阴真经才会释放黄蓉最终郭靖会否为救出黄蓉而就范?

programme.title: 保镖
programme.desc: 洛阳无敌庄庄主失去了所有功力,于是请来侄儿与未婚妻一起护送黄金前往京城在途中,他们遇到了一名神秘侠客,三人随即联手对抗盗匪,竭力保护黄金不被劫走

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神
programme.desc: 军阀割据时代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的传统骗术层出不穷,「蛇神」、「李三脚」、「三只手」等一群妖言惑众的骗徒令人云亦云的愚民上钓,反映旧时代一切牛鬼蛇神众生相

programme.title: 射雕英雄传
programme.desc: 郭靖回到中原时,遇上黄蓉,二人一见钟情双双堕入爱河岂料,同时间欧阳克竟又向黄蓉提亲于是黄药师决定以比武选婿,对决的胜方可娶女儿黄蓉为妻经过一轮激战,郭靖最后成功打败欧阳克,夺得美人归

programme.title: 蝴蝶杯
programme.desc: 明朝时代,书生田玉川因替渔夫伸张正义,误杀总督之子,被迫逃亡走投无路时,他逃至江畔,幸得渔夫之女相救二人在险境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以传家至宝「蝴蝶杯」为信物,缔结终身之约

programme.title: 群英会
programme.desc: 本片由三个单元故事组成,为岳枫、程刚及张彻联合执导,当年就有「花一张票价,看三套电影」的称誉岳枫之〈铁弓缘〉讲述一对青年男女因一把铁弓而结缘、程刚之〈胭脂虎〉讲述一群绝色妓女的故事、张彻之〈白水滩〉讲述梁山英雄后代的故事

programme.title: 鬼新娘
programme.desc: 方明在赶路途中邂逅神秘年轻女子冷秋屏,两人情投意合并私订终身婚后方明惊觉妻子竟是受邪灵操控、被迫吸取男子精气的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害最终在道士相助下,方明击败邪灵救出爱妻,然而人鬼殊途,两人于晨光中凄然诀别,冷秋屏含泪投胎转世

programme.title: 插翅难飞
programme.desc: 邓彪因为黑货买卖失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出从中陷害者,高明说出乃黑豹所为后,即被开枪杀死,邓彪因此被判监禁十五年他出狱后即找黑豹报仇,却遇上势力庞大的葛八爷干扰;同时商琳为寻失踪十五年的丈夫,欲找邓彪查问黑豹下落,但两人仅听过黑豹其名,从未见其人,究竟黑豹是谁?

programme.title: 欲燄狂流
programme.desc: 故事描述饰花花公子的乔庄与好友杨帆,同时爱上胡燕妮,但杨成人之美但乔因生殖力弱,故当胡怀孕时,就怀疑妻与杨有染…

programme.title: 来如风
programme.desc: 明皇身染恶疾,驾崩在即,却无子可继帝位;皇侄世子杰本可继位,惜不成器,难当大任皇弟徽王想起明皇曾与东宫宫女生有子女各一,现时藏匿于东阳县,遂命锦衣卫刘玄平寻找公主与王子的下落刘玄平路上屡遭世子杰爪牙追杀,幸得侠士来如风相助

programme.title: 杨乃武与小白菜

programme.title: 超兽 #2

programme.title: 大猫九命 #1

programme.title: 野性菲律宾 #2

programme.desc: 佛罗里达群岛是美国南部的第一道防线凭借丰富的海军历史和沿海生活方式,不难相信当地人声称那是多达1000艘沉船残骸的家

programme.title: 野性菲律宾 #1

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟随丹与他的团队,一同在「老兄」的领地中嗅探,追踪,他们怀疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能远比先前想像的更加关键,更具影响力当丹意外发现一群雪豹聚集的反常现象时,对雪豹行为的既有研究与认知也因此受到冲击与挑战

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和狮子西尔加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人类好友瓦尔自她还是失去父母的幼崽时就一直在她身边看乌鸦洛基逗乐他的挚友艾略特,与𫚉鱼哈格尔依偎拥抱,并了解为什么无尾熊崔许与盖瑞就像一家人

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1

programme.title: 野性厄瓜多 #2

programme.title: 巨型长毛象的足迹
programme.desc: 这具百万年历史的巨大杜尔福长毛象骨骸,急需进行世界首创的紧急修复我们跟随这个艰巨的拆卸和重组脆弱化石的过程透过电脑成像技术(CGI)和博物馆知识,这部影片让这个引人入胜却鲜为人知的巨型生物重获「生命」

programme.title: 犀牛孤儿院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤儿院需要耐性与忠诚,因为他们要抚养那些因偷猎而失去母亲的年轻犀牛

programme.title: 犀牛孤儿院 #2
programme.desc: 两头最老的犀牛将重返大自然三头犀牛的失踪引起哄动,而年轻的犀牛则逐渐康复和变得快乐

programme.title: 犀牛孤儿院 #3
programme.desc: 偷猎危机加剧,偷猎者将注意力转向孤儿们四周大的牙美拿失去母亲后终于在犀牛孤儿院找到庇护

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了独特的野生生态从南部的西班牙栓皮栎森林到北部的落叶林,从交配到野外生存,跟随标志性物种所经历的关键生命阶段

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅:苏格兰 #3
programme.desc: 艾伦的奢华列车之旅持续展开,欣赏车厢美景,了解卡洛登的历史,在普洛克顿观察海豹,聆听牧牛故事,体验驾驶列车,品尝威士忌,观察老鹰,并在乡间享受瑜伽的宁静时光

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅:苏格兰 #4
programme.desc: Alan 展开一段罕见旅程,航行至爱奥那与斯塔法,参观司康宫与邓迪 VA 博物馆,与百老汇老友重聚,品尝欧本的海鲜,最后在福斯桥旁参加凯利舞会作为告别

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #1
programme.desc: 在圣露西亚,双胞胎惊喜现身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探险、丛林健行、极致享受的巧克力按摩、兰姆酒品鉴,热带乐趣无限延伸!

programme.title: 惠妮休斯顿: 天籁背后
programme.desc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描绘惠妮休斯顿如流星般崛起的人生——从福音音乐的根源到全球巨星的巅峰,揭开错综复杂的情感关系、与成瘾搏斗的阴影,以及那把曾无可动摇、最终令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #8

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: It is one of China's most revered mountains A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around

programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.title: 地球大神秘(国语)

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 主日讲坛-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 讲题:有限人生无限爱 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 福音电影专线:翻生奇兵

programme.title: LAW霸女神粤

programme.title: 面包超人粤日

programme.title: 马百良六宝灵芝呈献:最强生命线粤 及 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 睡食症是一种发生在睡眠期间的异常行为，病人会在半梦半醒、无意识的状态下进食，甚至吃下生肉等食物，醒来后往往对过程毫无记忆。此症常见由传统安眠药引起，因此对于长期或大量服用安眠药的病人、长者及曾有病史的人士而言，有睡食症的机率会相对较高。患者亦会因常在夜间无意识进食、煮食而引致危险及导致体重上升。

programme.title: 与厨同行 家乐牌专业餐饮呈献：美食强人粤
programme.desc: 内地食店容易购入新鲜乳鸽，而香港餐厅受限于冰鲜货，这先天差异可会左右这趟乳鸽菜肴评级的结果？广州珠江新城的星级名店，舍弃主流的红烧做法，改以盐焗烹调乳鸽。不过，四只鸽腿索价破百元，有名厨公开乳鸽来货价，反映CP值甚低；另一名厨甚至以港式快餐店炸鸡作比喻。香港代表则大玩中西融合，厨师将法式嫩煎鸽胸搭配炸酿鸽髀，带来一鸽二食。现场评审大多给予高分肯定，但嘉宾森美敏锐点出，某细项的评分偏低，有何见解？

programme.title: 高朋满座#224粤
programme.desc: 三妗婆要高家众人协助赶制过年吃的萝卜糕，朋无奈答应。完成后，朋准备不眠不休地进行大扫除，突发现遗失了结婚戒指！朋怀疑戒指已混入萝卜糕馅料中，可惜大部分萝卜糕已分发给亲友。朋与溢立即进行「回收行动」。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱．回家之三代同糖#68粤
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯，控制欲极强。万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰半生相夫教子，忽然「觉醒」，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中。当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活。万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断。职场上，富二代老板空降「营销大神」杨帆，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机……

programme.title: 保诚保险呈献：玫瑰战争#4粤PG
programme.desc: 德龙从无双处取回子盈之物，并回想与子盈的甜蜜往昔。菲雅在过去已情倾德龙，当年得知德龙与子盈在一起时，竟藉拍戏公报私仇。未几，子盈便陷入丑闻风波。子盈即使丑闻缠身，仍获云生包容，惹来凤仪妒忌……云生打算全力推动串流平台计划，凤仪倾力协助，向无双明言无暇抽身拍摄《玫瑰》，并指绮云、菲雅亦已推辞，无双心下一沉……云生欲拉拢何氏基金合作，却遭主席何永康奚落，无双深信此事必能促使云生加速开拍《玫瑰》。

programme.title: 与厨同行 家乐牌专业餐饮呈献：美食强人粤
programme.desc: 虾饺展现点心师傅的极致手艺，「皮馅折蒸」步骤统统甚为讲究，平民小店、星级食府都有创意用心之作。铜锣湾的新派点心店以中西合璧做法，奉上破格的黑金虾饺，评审们却认为墨鱼汁皮反而令经典美食不再晶莹通透，黑松露亦遮盖了虾的鲜味，有所扣分？澳门某酒店中菜馆以金鱼为主题，将虾饺升呢艺术品。栩栩如生的「金鱼饺」，用上清甜爽脆的刺身级蓝天使虾，味道与卖相兼备！有名厨见证金鱼饺的「进化」，并形容是千锤百炼的成果。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 汉摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅罗×金明洙×成东镒，三人三色法官个性，寻找法庭正义！！】三位个性截然不同的法官，在现实与理想间的挣扎与选择。热血直率的新任法官及冷静理性的资深法官同事。每一场审判，都是对人性与制度的考验。在案件背后，他们不只判案，更在学习如何面对自己心中的「正义」。

programme.title: 风起西州
programme.desc: 【《风起霓裳》最新续作！！许魏洲、古力娜扎续夫妻情缘，琴瑟和鸣的婚后生活及事业新考验！！】制衣才女库狄琉璃与裴行俭婚后面对大长公主的屡次使计刁难，琉璃聪慧应对，化险为夷。裴行俭因意外被贬远赴西州上任，夫妻携手同心，琉璃发挥自己的长才，传授西州百姓制衣技巧。裴行俭则守护西州百姓经济富足、安居乐业。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 时光之城

Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a colorful and exciting 3D animated show full of music, dancing, and fun adventures! It follows BarryTiger and his lovable friends as they play, learn, and discover new things every day. With happy songs, cheerful characters, and amazing places to visit, each episode brings smiles and laughter. The music is made by real musicians, so every tune is catchy and sounds great! Get ready to sing along, move to the beat, and have a roaring good time with BarryTiger!

programme.desc: A dramedy about two estranged brothers from Normandy. Antoine is happily married with two kids and a successful boat driver, whereas Christian is a globe-trotting hustler. When Antoine becomes involved in sleazy activities, Christian comes to his rescue.

programme.desc: Benjamin dreams of being a great doctor, but his internship at his father’s ward doesn’t turn out the way he hoped. His experience as a junior doctor, with its overwhelming responsibility and stiff competition, forces him to confront his limits and fears.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir loves Narges and Narges loves Amir. But their hopes and dreams for a life together collide head on with the web of tradition, corruption, and social hierarchy that continues to rule over the lives of a new generation in Iran.

programme.title: Mountain Woman
programme.desc: When famine overruns a small Japanese village, Rin must leave the village in order to protect her father accused of theft. Rin heads deep into Mt. Hayachin, and crosses the forbidden mountain god's shrine, where the goddess of thieves is said to dwell.

programme.title: Train Driver's Diary
programme.desc: As Ilija nears retirement, his record of unintentional deaths as a train driver weighs heavy. His adopted son, Sima, fears following in his footsteps. But as days pass without incident, Ilija's determination to ensure Sima's success takes a dark turn.

programme.title: Remember To Blink
programme.desc: Jacqueline adopts two children from a foreign country with her husband. To help with translation, the kids are accompanied by Gabriele, a twenty-year old who is just starting to taste the sweetness of feeling power.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement
programme.desc: After waking in a hospital with no memory, Sarah Kohr is accused of shooting an innocent man following a violent accident. Determined to clear her name, she sets out to uncover the truth of what really happened that night.

programme.title: Running On Sand
programme.desc: When an Eritrean refugee about to be deported from Israel is mistaken for the Nigerian striker just signed to a struggling soccer team, his fate depends on the team’s success in this charming, socially relevant dramedy.

programme.title: Tuesday Club
programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.desc: At her wedding in the Auvergne mountains, Lucie survives a lightning strike that kills her husband but leaves her with the ability to remember every moment of her life. At a reunion two years later, the survivors are targeted by a mysterious killer.

programme.title: Life Feels Good
programme.desc: The true story of Mateusz, a man suffering from cerebral palsy, who in his early childhood had been diagnosed as a retard with no contact with the outside world. After twenty-five years it turned out that he was a perfectly normal and intelligent person.

programme.title: Milk Teeth
programme.desc: Living in a small rural community, Skalde navigates societal stigma due to having an “outsider” mother. When she befriends a mysterious girl in the woods, Skalde jeopardizes everything, struggling to balance loyalty to her community and her newfound bond.

programme.title: Complicity
programme.desc: Inspired by a real-life incident. Cheng Liang, a Chinese illegal immigrant in Japan finds new direction when he fakes his identity and lands an apprenticeship with a master soba chef. However, the threat of deportation always lurks around the corner.

programme.title: Elaha
programme.desc: Elaha, a young Kurdish-German woman, battles patriarchy and family expectations while seeking her own path. Elaha struggles with traditions, marriage and virginity, and she must choose between emancipation or delusion.

programme.title: Forever-Forever
programme.desc: In late 90s Kyiv, rebellious Tonia joins a gang, seeking protection and belonging. Amidst the ruins of the post-soviet city, she finds herself tangled up in a secret love triangle and confronting her abusive past.

programme.title: What's for Dinner, Mom?
programme.desc: Sisters Tae and Yo return to their childhood home and discover a box of recipes and letters from their late Japanese mother. As Tae uncovers her mother’s hidden struggles, she journeys to Taiwan to retrace her past through memory and food.

programme.title: Snow
programme.desc: In the heart of winter, several notables are found murdered. To advance investigations, Captain Delhaye decides to bring Juliette Hémon out of prison for a few days. The young woman had been imprisoned some years earlier for a strangely similar case.

programme.title: The Beautiful Spark
programme.desc: After losing his job in a scandal, Michelin-starred chef Philippe gets a second chance at La Belle Étincelle - a unique restaurant run by Virginie, and staffed by her autistic son Noé alongside other young people with disabilities.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Inspired by real life events, two teenage girls in search of freedom and belonging leave the UK behind on a secret, dangerous journey to Syria. When their plan falls apart in Istanbul, they're forced to go it alone, testing everything they believe in.

programme.title: Unsinkable

programme.title: Our Children
programme.desc: A doctor brings a boy to Belgium and raises him as his own. When the boy reaches manhood, he gets married and starts his own family, but he still relies on the doctor, his adoptive father. When trouble strikes his family, dependence turns into domination.

programme.title: East Frisian: Oath

programme.title: The Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: Elise is beautiful, funny, and blind. Theo is a seducer but a loser. They love music. But when they meet in the elevator, it's hate at first sight.

programme.title: Delicious

programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Nomads, Mongolia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is out on a camping expedition in Mongolia. There's not much around except a group of Mongolian nomads - people who travel around the country with their animals, camping in amazing tents called gers. Glitch visits their camp and inadvertently offends them, then his misfiring jetpack causes him to land on one of their precious horses, causing it to gallop away from the camp with Glitch on its back!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: A little railway show comes to Sodor and a misunderstanding leads to all the small engines on railway turning up at Ulfstead Castle to participate.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Missing Appalams﻿
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay are detectives today. When the homemade appalams go missing under their watch, they need to solve the case and save lunch.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel
programme.desc: Benjamin and Sophie have a new bug friend. Stanley helps build a bug feeder which attracts lots more bugs. They eat so much; Stanley gets more food and builds a Bug Hotel for them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Penguins Live in Igloos
programme.desc: Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time for a treasure hunt
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran join Jaxon and Ezra in the park for Cynthia's pirate-themed treasure hunt. Who will be the first to find the treasure? Come on, shipmates, and set sail with JoJo and Gran Gran!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Bus Ride
programme.desc: Maisy drives the bus to pick up all of her friends! Where are they going?

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Shopping
programme.desc: Maisy goes shopping for groceries, but forgets what was on her shopping list.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.desc: Evil Pea tricks Supertato by pretending to be his sidekick and captures him instead.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Trouble Bubbles
programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea get stuck inside a giant floating bubble together.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Where? There!
programme.desc: Laa‐Laa and Po play a game of 'hide and seek'. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dispsy are hiding too and Laa‐Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Scooter
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'scooter' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different scooters - a purple scooter, a blue scooter and a bopping scooter.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - OKIDO in Bloom
programme.desc: Messy watches his sandcastle get washed away by the pouring rain. Why does it have to rain? He finds out why.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Piggyin the Riddle
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.desc: In order to help protect a sandcastle that he and Tala built, Glitch uses a giant vacuum to suck up the sand from the Academy's beach, exposing the illusive ghost crabs to the hungry seagulls up above. To make matters worse, Glitch and his Grimbots lose control of the vacuum, causing chaos in the ocean. Can the Go Jetters protect the crabs while also returning the sand to its proper place?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Copycat
programme.desc: Bluey's having fun copying everything Dad says and does, but the game takes a serious turn when Bluey finds a hurt budgie and they have to make an emergency trip to the vet.

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium and big sticks... Lots of sticks!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Kittens
programme.desc: Maisy goes to Kiki's house to play with some kittens, and one wants to come home with her!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Bus Ride
programme.desc: Maisy drives the bus to pick up all of her friends! Where are they going?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Pepper
programme.desc: Pepper performs a bell ringing act.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Trouble Bubbles
programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea get stuck inside a giant floating bubble together.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Not So Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea tricks Supertato into thinking that he's lost all of his superpowers.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Where? There!
programme.desc: Laa‐Laa and Po play a game of 'hide and seek'. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dispsy are hiding too and Laa‐Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?
